name: yf_screener
description:
Yahoo Finance predefined stock screens (day gainers, losers, most active, most shorted and others), through yfinance's screen function.
Returns: {screen_type, title, total (stocks matching the screen), count, results: [{symbol, shortName, exchange, currency, regularMarketPrice, regularMarketChange, regularMarketChangePercent, regularMarketVolume, marketCap, trailingPE, fiftyTwoWeekHigh, fiftyTwoWeekLow, ...}]} or {screen_type, error}.
Inputs (* required): screen_type (day_gainers, day_losers, most_actives, most_shorted_stocks, small_cap_gainers, undervalued_large_caps, aggressive_small_caps, growth_technology_stocks, undervalued_growth_stocks; default day_gainers); limit (stocks, 1-250; default 25).
Custom filters: openbb_equity_screener; trending names: yf_trending_tickers.
Example: {"screen_type": "most_actives", "limit": 10}
